description: This file contains setup and configuration functions for the LINE channel integration within the openclaw plugin SDK, including account configuration, validation, and adapter setup.

classes.name: ChannelSetupAdapter
classes.description: Interface for channel setup adapters, defining methods for account resolution, configuration application, and validation.

methods.name: patchLineAccountConfig
methods.description: Modifies the OpenClawConfig to update or clear LINE account settings based on provided parameters.

methods.name: isLineConfigured
methods.description: Checks if a given LINE account is properly configured with credentials.
